applies_to: a KIND: (layer, source, category, element_class) of a grid ec_keys entry. Rules are tried in order; the first whose every condition holds assigns the class. A condition lists accepted values; category matches are exact strings as Revit's Category.Name recorded them (English; Category.Name is localized, so a non-English project's categories fall to the default and are listed as unmapped rather than guessed).
notes: Every rule records basis 'stated' (named in the A2 brief, 2026-10-05), 'observed' (seen in a real run's inventory) or 'inferred' (an API class name or category string the brief did not give). The inferred ones are to be checked against stage_a_kinds.py inventory on real runs.
1.1 (2026-10-05): Dimension subclasses (LinearDimension observed on run 1005_1018) map to dimension.
filled_region: masking and filled regions share the FilledRegion class; IsMasking is NOT captured, so the class does not say which.
dimension: the reference linkage of a dimension is not captured, so nothing here says a dimension is model-linked.
keynote_unknown_kind: the keynote's kind (element / material / user) is not captured.

import_view_owned: a view-owned DWG is on the ANNOTATION layer under Stage A (decision D1); the geometry path counted it as Model + Ext. It is reported as its own class and its own legacy bucket, folded into neither. The disposition is Greg's and is open.

rules.note: stated: keynote tags -> keynote_unknown_kind. Inferred: the category name. Before the tag rule because a keynote is an IndependentTag.

Observed on run 20261005T101900_e998b46 (1005_1018): Revit reports linear dimensions as the Dimension subclass LinearDimension (18 keys, 6 views, category Dimensions), which the exact-class rule above missed.
Inferred: the other Dimension subclasses in the Revit API, by the same reasoning as LinearDimension.
stated: spot dimensions are dimensions. Inferred: the API class name SpotDimension.
stated: detail curves. Inferred: the API class names.
Inferred: the API class of an elevation marker.

Inferred: the category names of section, callout and reference viewers (OST_Viewers, OST_SectionMarks, OST_CalloutHeads, OST_ReferenceViewer). Their API class is the generic Element, so category is the only handle.

legacy_bucket.source: vop_interwoven/revit/annotation.py classify_annotation / classify_keynote, normalised by final_state_scanner._normalize_anno_type (ANNO_BUCKETS)

rules.note: Not a v1 bucket: the geometry path counted a view-owned DWG as Model + Ext, not annotation (A5).
OST_Dimensions only: spot dimensions have their own categories and fell to OTHER.

classify_annotation's tag list (OST_RoomTags, OST_SpaceTags, OST_AreaTags, OST_DoorTags, OST_WindowTags, OST_WallTags, OST_MEPSpaceTags, OST_GenericAnnotation); inferred: their Category.Name. Any other tag category fell to OTHER.
classify_keynote returns TAG unless the keynote has an empty key (TEXT); the key is not captured, so its default.

model_class.note: Substring on the upper-cased category, in this order. The resolver's explicit meta['class'] branch has no Stage A input (no class is captured), so only the category branch applies.
